<role>

<definition>

Compare the problem itself, not the product area. A spike that is unstarted or in progress is not shipped.
Fail if a completed story solves the same problem, or a roadmap item already covers it.
The evidence is the problem statement and the five most similar stories and roadmap pages, with status and dates.

response.content: {"critique": "I checked the problem statement (slow claims processing causing policyholder loss of confidence) against the five similar items. None address this problem: the milestone notifications page (sim 0.072) is about informing policyholders, not speeding processing; the Summer and September release notes (sim 0.071, 0.053) only generically mention performance improvements with no evidence of solving processing speed or trust; the Task overview (sim 0.048) is an internal dashboard; and Shortcut story 4131 (completed 2026-09-15) is about workspace administration, an unrelated problem. No shipped story or roadmap item covers the core problem.", "verdict": "pass"}
